dedupe_keys.name: awesome transit community list of open public transit standards data apis and tools mobilitydata

description: awesome-transit is a community list, maintained under MobilityData, of data standards, APIs, applications, tools, datasets and research around open technology for public transit. Its README frames open technology as open standards, open data and open source software, from consumer applications such as OpenTripPlanner to developer tools such as the GTFS Validator, and includes technologies that are open source themselves or rely on open standards and data. Anyone can propose additions by pull request or issue. Coverage: worldwide. Format and access: a Markdown list in a public repository with an RSS feed. Licence and cost: CC0 1.0, free. Caveats: a curated pointer list, not a data store; entries vary in upkeep and some links go stale. It helps find GTFS feeds, APIs and tools for network flow and capacity planning models of transit systems. It relates to the Mobility Database, Transitland and the GTFS specification records in the catalogue.
